home.e9445bbb:
Capitello Group,
at the heart of several revolutions
home.e137c956:
Capitello Group was founded in 2013 to advise business leaders seeking to grow and adapt to changes in their environment. The company has since expanded into three other sectors that are all undergoing particularly significant transformations: Mobility, Media, and Healthcare.
These "three Ms," as Arnaud Molinié refers to them, are sectors he knows particularly well, having been involved in them in various capacities throughout his career.
Capitello Group's ambition is to help transform these three sectors by joining forces with leading partners and developing start-ups.
To this end, the group is now structured into four business lines: Capitello Consulting, Capitello Media, Capitello Move, and a Health division.

about.ebd24633: A group structured into four divisions
about.e40a2c10: Transform the Mobility, Media and Medical sectors by teaming up with partners and developing start-ups.
about.ea72ae11: Capitello Group was created in 2013 to advise managers of companies wishing to grow and adapt to changes in their environment. Arnaud Molinié has assisted them in raising funds, setting up industrial and commercial partnerships, and acquiring strategic stakes.
about.ebb11edb:
Media: an undiminished passion
Arnaud Molinié's passion for the media has never left him, and he's always been keen to devote part of his time to it.
about.e8cc6f2a:
At Capitello Media, this translates into :

  • a strategic stake in PTC (Paris Television Center), which is used by foreign media correspondents in France, as well as by companies for certain communications operations;
  • co-production of documentaries, including Everest, la Déesse Mère, by David Vital-Aymard (Injam Production; TV8 Mont Blanc), which won the "Best Documentary Long" award at the Everest International Film Festival 2025.

U1st Vision at VivaTech 2024
about.ea3bfeae: Mobilities: towards increasingly connected and decarbonized service offerings. At Deloitte and as Senior SVP at Renault, Arnaud Molinié worked on the challenges of new forms of mobility. Under the combined effect of demographic and societal changes, and the possibilities offered by technology, a radical transformation of uses is underway towards connected, low-carbon, serviced mobility. It's a veritable revolution, overturning our relationship with the automobile, with consumption and with life in the city. For public decision-makers, it's one of the answers to the colossal challenge of the energy transition and the consequences of the concentration of populations in metropolises. Capitello Move's ambition is to open up new avenues through innovative mobility offers via strategic partnerships: whether in the field of fine particle emission control, charging networks for electric and hybrid vehicles, or the design and creation of vehicles dedicated to specific uses (healthcare vehicles, for example, with the U1st Vision concept, presented at VivaTech 2024).

about.e56c1702: Deloitte enhances its health plan by including a new preventive health check-up service in partnership with Doxamed
about.e2cf0654:
Health: the vital issue of access to care
The health emergency in the spring of 2020 has highlighted territorial and social inequalities in access to care, and the need for sustainable solutions to relieve hospital overcrowding and combat medical deserts.
Doxamed is the fruit of the intuitions that Arnaud Molinié shared with Gérard Déprez, CEO of the Loxam Group, to respond to this challenge by combining the use of the most sophisticated technologies, remote intervention by doctors and partnerships with laboratories.
about.e1d93e39:
Doxamed :

  • has become a trusted partner for companies, local authorities, events (cultural, sporting, professional), theaters and theme parks, providing them with tailor-made solutions;
  • is now involved in sustainable projects with local authorities and companies to improve access to healthcare in coordination with its partners (doctors, nurses, medical laboratories, etc.).
about.efafe2d5:
In 2023, Doxamed won a competitive bidding process launched by SNCF Gares & Connexions to set up nearly 300 health spaces in train stations by 2028 (with a potential total of 1,735). The first health center opened its doors at the Épinay-sur-Orge station in January 2025.
Doxamed is also in advanced discussions with several companies to support them in developing health prevention measures for their employees, and has signed a major contract in this area with Groupe ADP, Bpifrance, and Deloitte France.
about.e4688e95: Capitello Group strengthens its leadership in MedTech with the acquisition of Teledok
about.eeeb9a03: A pioneer in telemedicine platforms for doctors, Teledok was founded in 2018 by Dr. François Teboul and Dr. Stéphane Illouz. Teledok aims to serve healthcare by modernizing access to care through the provision of its doctors to telemedicine operators. Today, Teledok brings together general practitioners and specialists, as well as paramedical professionals, dedicated to building, evaluating, and providing human resources for telemedicine projects.
